notes: Atlas Copco GA55 oil-injected screw compressor with Elektronikon MkIV controller. Modbus via Combox-S gateway (RS485 proxy to CAN network). Addresses are decimal. Analogue inputs are paired: odd=status, even=value. Counters are 32-bit (2×16-bit registers, big-endian). The actual sensor-to-register mapping depends on compressor configuration (features/options) — use AC FDP tool to verify input assignments for your specific machine. This profile uses the TYPICAL GA55 sensor layout. Source: 9820 3582 02, Edition 12 (2012).
address_note: Register addresses are 0-based (as documented). FC03 for holding registers, FC01 for coils. The Combox-S proxy maps CAN node IDs to Modbus slave addresses — configure via FDP tool.

registers.description: Analogue Input 1 — Value. Typical GA55: Discharge pressure (mbar). 0x7FFF = sensor error.
Analogue Input 1 — Status. Bit0=pre-warning, Bit1=warning, Bit2=shutdown-warning, Bit3=shutdown, Bit4=service, Bit5=permissive-start, Bit6=sensor-error, Bit7=input-set.
Analogue Input 2 — Value. Typical GA55: Element outlet temperature (0.1°C). 0x7FFF = sensor error.
Analogue Input 3 — Value. Typical GA55: Oil injection temperature (0.1°C).
Analogue Input 4 — Value. Typical GA55: Motor current (0.1A). 0x7FFF = sensor error.
Analogue Input 5 — Value. Typical GA55: Oil pressure differential (mbar).
CMS (high byte: Compressor Mechanical State) + COM (low byte). CMS: 01=stopped, 02=unloaded, 04=loaded. Low byte = communication state.
CS (high byte: Compressor Status state number) + CCM (low byte: Controller Mode). CCM: 00=local, 01=remote-digital, 02=remote-comms.

General Status bitfield. Bit0=pre-warning, Bit1=general-warning, Bit2=shutdown-warning, Bit3=general-shutdown, Bit4=general-service, Bit5=start-failure, Bit6=emergency-stop, Bit7=manual/auto, Bit8=local/remote, Bit9=timer-active, Bit10=pre-warn-service-hours, Bit11=pre-warn-service-m3.
Running Hours counter (in seconds, scale converts to hours). 32-bit: reg 301 (high) + reg 302 (low).
Loaded Hours counter (seconds → hours). Load% = loaded_hours / running_hours × 100.
Motor Starts counter. High start count = excessive cycling (check pressure band or system sizing).
Accumulated compressed air volume. Use with load_hours for specific power (kW/m³).
Required motor speed (VSD setpoint). Only on VSD models (GA55 VSD).
Actual motor speed motor 1. Only on VSD models. Compare with setpoint for regulation quality.
Loading pressure band 1 (mbar). Compressor loads when network pressure drops to this value.
Unloading pressure band 1 (mbar). Compressor unloads when network pressure reaches this value.

registers._note: Coils require FC01 (read coil status), not FC03. The runtime needs FC01 support (roadmap v0.2) to read these. Listed here for documentation.

registers.description: COIL 0001: Running (0=stopped, 1=running). NOTE: Requires FC01 support (not yet implemented). Use general_status register 403 instead.
